thread:
maya: Heads-up — onboarding paperwing12b (v1.0-int4) canary is hitting OOMs with default max_new_tokens=512. Observed memory spike during KV prefetch and lots of small slab allocations. :bug:

josh: Ugh. Seen similar with other 12b int4s. Can you paste the tail of the pod log? :eyes:

maya: Pasting relevant snippet:```
E OOM on device 0: failed to allocate 128MB (cudaMalloc)
2026-03-23T10:14:22Z slot_alloc: slab_count=482 free_slots=12
KV prefetch range requested=4096 tokens
batch_size=8, max_new_tokens=512
```

li: Two quick thoughts — (1) prefetched KV window of 4k seems excessive for typical prompts, (2) batch=8 might be pushing memory. Try lowering max_new_tokens to 256 and microbatch to 4 for the canary.

sara: Also try enabling aggressive kv-evict: `KV_EVICT_THRESHOLD=0.6` for the canary, and turn on slot compaction: `COMPACT_ON_EVICT=true`. Those helped for a similar case.

maya: Trying changes now. Will run a canary with:```
export MAX_NEW_TOKENS=256
export MICRO_BATCH=4
export KV_PREFETCH=1024
export KV_EVICT_THRESHOLD=0.6
# roll canary via deploy tool
deploy canary paperwing12b-v1.0-int4 --ratio 5% --tag=prefetch-tweak
```

deploy-bot: deploy started for paperwing12b-v1.0-int4 (canary 5%) — pod ids: p-72, p-73. Logs will stream to /logs/paperwing/canary-prefetch-tweak.

josh: If that still OOMs, fallback plan: (A) switch to int8-quant variant for canary, (B) add soft-fallback to smaller model (paperwing7b) on OOM error path.

li: Also add an eval comparing output quality int4 vs int8 at the new max_new_tokens=256 for 100 eval prompts — just to catch regressions early.

maya: Canary results: two pods p-72 and p-73 completed 80 requests each, no OOMs so far. Latency + cost looks nominal. Will run the full eval now.

sara: Nice. When you run eval, include these metrics: perplexity delta, rouge-l, and a small human QA check on 20 open-ended prompts. Log the eval job id.

maya: Eval job id: eval-20260323-paperwing-pf1. Quick summary: int4@256 vs baseline fp16@512 — quality delta is negligible on most prompts, rouge-l drop ~0.8%, perplexity +0.4. Cost per request down ~22%.

josh: Sounds acceptable. Suggest we update model defaults: MAX_NEW_TOKENS=256 and MICRO_BATCH=4 in the model profile, and add an automatic kv_prefetch clamp to min(prefetch, 1024) for small prompts. Also create a rollout note documenting kv-evict threshold change.

li: I'll open a PR to change the model profile and add a regression guard in the eval harness (thresholds: rouge-l > -2% or fail).

maya: Will attach the canary logs and eval artifacts to the model onboarding ticket. Thanks all. :thumbsup:

sara: Nice triage. Let's mark action items: 1) PR to model-profile (li), 2) add runtime guard (josh), 3) update runbook with KV prefetch guidance (maya).

maya: Done — ticket #MLON-1129 updated with links to eval-20260323-paperwing-pf1 and logs.

deploy-bot: canary deployment completed successfully — 0 OOMs, 98% healthy.

josh: Great outcome. We should also schedule a follow-up to test stress scenarios (high concurrency, long conversations) before promoting to Dedicated.

maya: Agreed — scheduling stress test next week.
